nodes.name: Manual run - one historical date
nodes.notes: Manual UI runs use the defaults in Run configuration. No schedule exists.

nodes.name: Controlled webhook run
nodes.notes: Controlled evidence runs only. Header-authenticated, no schedule, deactivated after the run.

nodes.name: Run configuration
nodes.notes: One morning or a bounded batch of up to 40 mornings, a validation label and any registered model selection. Defaults to the frozen research challengers on 2024-01-10.

nodes.name: Fetch committed panel
nodes.notes: Reads the same checked-in run-v1.json the local controller reads. No provider or warehouse read.

nodes.name: Select one saved morning
nodes.notes: The dataset decides whether each morning exists. One item per requested date; a missing date is passed as a null session so every selected model returns an explicit block.

nodes.name: Bind Challenger v0
nodes.notes: Selects usd-layer1-challenger-v0 for every requested morning, and emits nothing when the run did not select it.

nodes.name: Run Challenger v0
nodes.notes: Separately versioned Layer 1 workflow pinned to usd-layer1-challenger-v0.

nodes.name: Bind Challenger v1
nodes.notes: Selects usd-layer1-challenger-v1 for every requested morning, and emits nothing when the run did not select it.

nodes.name: Run Challenger v1
nodes.notes: Separately versioned Layer 1 workflow pinned to usd-layer1-challenger-v1.

nodes.name: Bind Fixture - constant USD bullish (not a research model)
nodes.notes: Selects usd-layer1-fixture-constant-v0 for every requested morning, and emits nothing when the run did not select it.

nodes.name: Run Fixture - constant USD bullish (not a research model)

workflowId.cachedResultName: USD Layer 1 - Fixture - constant USD bullish (not a research model) (Cloud adapter)

nodes.notes: Separately versioned Layer 1 workflow pinned to usd-layer1-fixture-constant-v0.

nodes.name: Compare the selected models
nodes.notes: Reports exactly the selected models per morning, with their execution links and the experiment identity. It never re-scores a child result, never invents a missing one and never selects a winner from performance.

nodes.name: Return paired record
nodes.notes: Carries every per-morning record to the responder. A response that returned only the first item would lose the rest of the batch.

nodes.name: Respond with every record
nodes.notes: Returns the whole batch as one JSON array. The default last-node response only returns the first item, which silently truncated a 20-morning request to one record.

parameters.content: Research only. Calls separately versioned frozen Layer 1 workflows through the same contract, driven by the model registry. Reads one committed historical panel, writes no warehouse row, places no order and publishes no live call. Manual and controlled-webhook triggers only; no schedule. A fixture model registered alongside the books is labelled a fixture and never pooled with them.
